pullReadback.title: Give Version Control Services Section its own public source repository
pullReadback.body:
Select the dedicated public Version Control Services Section repository while preserving the original source and current Git/Software Forge selections. The exact original13 regular files (157,173 bytes), dated inactive legacy implementation/tests/ownership/host requirements and both child gitlinks remain available under the new source owner. The current Software Forge advance is preserved.

This replaces the embedded section with its received source gitlink, relocates only the two child declarations into that section and adds one curated source-composition record. All50 unrelated parent leaves and21 other module declarations are unchanged. The original parent history remains intact; no runtime package/version or historical/native capability qualification is claimed.

The complete projection is independently received (8449bda7500922b3720d6427089ef1b85506df9c3b82a6b957feb22fe44c1f67); there are no current parent workflows. This ready PR is intended for the original authenticated source-handoff bridge and scheduled intake pulse. It will not be manually merged.

@@ -1,23 +0,0 @@
-# Version Control Services Section
-
-This section contains services and small utilities for ordinary Git repository
-and forge operations.
-
-## Git services
-
-`git-services-section` uses `/usr/bin/git` directly. Its utilities observe
-repositories, parse `.gitmodules`, inspect gitlinks, commit named paths, push
-with `--recurse-submodules=check`, and perform explicit submodule maintenance.
-
-It does not replace Git, inject hooks, maintain command allowlists, serialize all
-Git operations, or install configuration in a user account.
-
-## Repository layout
-
-Submodules follow Git's standard model: the child repository owns its history,
-and the parent records an exact child commit as a gitlink. Publish a child commit
-before publishing a parent that points to it. Use recursive clone/update when a
-complete checkout is required.
-
-Git forge integrations live under the Git forge services subtree. Historical
-experiments remain under dated legacy directories and are not active tooling.

@@ -1,5 +0,0 @@
-# Host activation boundary
-
-This is an operator instruction, not an automatically applied configuration.
-
-To advertise `device-wide-enforced`, the host custodian must create a provider-owned systemd slice with cgroup-v2 `io` delegation for block device `8:48`, bind the service account/worktree permissions so governed clients cannot execute `/usr/bin/git` against the mounted territory outside the provider, and retain a tested emergency override. Record the resulting unit, cgroup path, device identity, permitted principals, and independent denial witness in this node's `data/` ledger. Until then, the executable service advertises only cooperative Git serialization.
